name: Fei Sa Zau Naai
summary:
Fei Sa Zau Naai is a cooking and time-management game set behind the tea bar of a cha chaan teng, a Hong Kong-style cafe, in Sham Shui Po. The cafe's rent has been raised, and as its new apprentice the player has three weeks to help pay it, learning the trade from the staff and getting to know twelve regulars along the way.

Each order arrives as a slip written in real cafe shorthand that the player must decode before making the drink or dish by hand: filling from the urn, pulling milk tea between two pots, adding evaporated or condensed milk, and frying French toast. Alongside the 21-day story, a daily challenge sends every player to the same cafe in one of Hong Kong's 18 districts, and ticket-rail battles pit the player against the computer or a friend. Dialogue is in Cantonese with English translation.
